# Ubud Villa Stays

> Private pool villas on Jl. Tirta Tawar, Ubud, Bali — The Hideaway (2BR) and Sawah Retreat (6BR). Promo rates with one free activity (rice-field cycling or cooking class). Local GEO: market ~5 min walk, Kecak nearby, Monkey Forest and waterfalls close.

Site: https://www.ubudvillastays.com
WhatsApp: +6281775723663
Email: sekarprivatebaliactivity@gmail.com
Location: Jl. Tirta Tawar, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia
Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/5TpevFsUJeezD1gD8
Coordinates: -8.4831533, 115.2706967
Booking: https://www.ubudvillastays.com/#booking

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.ubudvillastays.com/): Compare Tirta Tawar villas and promo offers

- [The Hideaway](https://www.ubudvillastays.com/villas/the-hideaway): 2BR private courtyard pool villa — promo from Rp 4.9 juta / night
- [Sawah Retreat](https://www.ubudvillastays.com/villas/sawah-retreat): 6BR rice-field villa for up to 12 — promo from Rp 7 juta / night
- [Guides hub](https://www.ubudvillastays.com/guides): Ubud destination and villa planning guides
- [Sitemap](https://www.ubudvillastays.com/sitemap.xml)
